about: The FDA answer keys (docs/SIMILARITY-LITERATURE.md, step 2), read from the fda_epc, fda_moa and fda_pe rows scripts/resolve_cohort_fda_classes.py writes. `epc`: two molecules sharing an Established Pharmacologic Class are classmates; sharing only a mechanism-of-action class earns half credit, except through the MoA classes below, which say how a drug is handled or nothing at all, never how it acts in the brain. `pe`: two molecules sharing a physiologic effect are classmates, unfiltered. A change to this file is a change of instrument: bump the version and say why in docs/SIMILARITY-HARNESS.md.

moa_no_credit_patterns.Cytochrome P450: pharmacokinetic: an enzyme that metabolises the drug or others (sertraline's 'Cytochrome P450 2D6 Inhibitors')

moa_no_credit_names.Enzyme Interactions: says nothing: which enzyme is the whole claim
moa_no_credit_names.Enzyme Inhibitors: says nothing: which enzyme is the whole claim (caffeine's only MoA)
moa_no_credit_names.Receptor Interactions: says nothing: which receptor is the whole claim
moa_no_credit_names.Acid-Base Activity: not a mechanism at a target
moa_no_credit_names.Electrolyte Activity: not a mechanism at a target
moa_no_credit_names.Osmotic Activity: not a mechanism at a target
